admission.justification: Measurement, journal and result reporting live in separate files, so one statement keeps an omitted parked line from being settled silently.

applicability: A sync whose resolution or interruption could drop work held in the parked candidate.
conditions: The sync parked a candidate and kept its stash.
Each omission is measured against the parked content, not taken from a label.
exclusions: A preview, which reports omissions and writes nothing.
Cache-only conflict or index state, which is not parked content.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_sync_parked_omissions.py (6 tests) and mcp/tests/test_sync_parked_candidate.py; final focused union

statement: An interrupted or resolved sync does not lose parked work: a resolution that omits lines or files the parked candidate held stops with sync-resolution-incomplete and an omission report, keeps the parked stash, and settles only when each omission is restored or reconciled with evidence the sync re-measures (a bare reconciled label is no evidence); preview reports omissions without writing.
